summary: Stateful staging tenant (staging_isolated) with run-scoped tagging, write-BOLA, a three-step checkout that trusts client pricing, and an h2c transfer endpoint vulnerable to a single-packet double-spend race.

findings.title: Invoice update ignores the caller tenant
findings.impact: tenant-alpha member rewrites tenant-beta invoice totals
evidence: PATCH inv-beta-1 with an alpha token returns 200 and bob observes total=1

findings.title: Report lookup is not tenant-scoped
findings.impact: cross-tenant revenue report and its canary are returned to an alpha member
evidence: rep-beta-1 returns rbs_fake_beta_report_canary to an alpha token

findings.title: Checkout payment trusts client-supplied pricing and skips the quote step
findings.impact: order total becomes 1 instead of the quoted 249; a cart can be paid without a quote

findings.title: HTTP/2 transfer race acknowledges two debits against one balance update
findings.impact: two same-packet streams with the same idempotency key both return 200 while the account is debited once (200 transferred against a 100 debit)
evidence: both streams observed balance 1000; final balance 900; deduplicated=false twice

chains.title: Cross-tenant staging takeover
chains.description: Enumerate a foreign report, then mutate the same tenant's invoice total; both actions are run-tagged and must be reverted by cleanup.

decoys.reason: Reads compare the invoice tenant with the token tenant and return 403 cross-tenant.
Quote always uses the server-side unit price; only the payment step is tamperable.
